notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Just a quick update regarding the game's release. It's been a little bit, but we're happy to say that the game is currently in final build review on Steam, and we're hoping to release in the last week of the month right now. 

Some screenshots until then: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36200905/b4c58016a87b9d148f6bb71383204be2793ab136.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36200905/51b056088dff16186391ae89dd4946c129b01508.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36200905/e2dfeb25082b986826e60b807fa9464723275db9.jpg[/img]

See you all on release day! We'll post more announcements as we get closer to release.
